name: Solve industrial process quality and efficiency issues
description: Users requested technical solutions, process improvements, and compliance mappings for industrial, manufacturing, and operational contexts. Specific tasks included identifying non-conformances against standards like ISO 9001, applying quality management methods such as HACCP and statistical process control, and developing strategies to reduce waste, energy consumption, and production inefficiencies.
